name: policy_observation_v1
purpose: Diagnose dominant navigation failures after full128 and failed distillation interventions. 2x2 native observation-mode/system-example comparison; diagnostic only, not baseline optimization or a performance evaluation.
selection: First16 failed episodes of completed fixed128, in seed order; a disclosed failure-conditioned development diagnostic, not held out. No selection by new outputs or shortest-route direction.
scope: One generation and one actual env.step per case/arm, at most5 actions. Same base b0 weights, same seed/map/dynamics/action parser. No self-distillation, skills, optimizer or checkpoints. Compare newly generated greedy arms, not old stochastic outputs.
input_boundary: Use official FrozenLake render_mode vision/text and use_example_in_sys_prompt true/false only. Text mode exposes the official symbolic grid as an explicit diagnostic observation alternative, not a faithful visual-policy replacement. No shortest path, correct action or verifier feedback is supplied.
known_issue_held_constant: Official system guide says tiles are slippery although configured dynamics are deterministic. Preserve this same wording across all four arms to avoid an extra confound; record separately rather than changing the frozen diagnostic.
metrics: first actual action reduces BFS distance
decision: An arm is a useful lead only if it improves first-action BFS progress on at least4 of16 paired cases and worsens at most1 vs matched control. This small selected sample is not generalization evidence; any change requires a separate fresh prospective validation. If no arm meets the gate, retain negative evidence and do not expand this fixed64-call diagnostic.
stop: Exactly64 calls maximum, no outcome-based replacement/retry, no full PPO or prompt search on the previous8 distillation cases. Repairs share first receipt deadline and cannot repeat completed calls.
